rules.description: Applicant or partner must be receiving a qualifying benefit
rules.reason_if_failed: You must be receiving Universal Credit, Income Support, income-based Jobseeker's Allowance, income-related Employment and Support Allowance, Pension Credit, or a Support for Mortgage Interest loan to qualify

rules.description: Usually no other children under 16 (exceptions for multiple births and special cases)
rules.reason_if_failed: The grant is usually only available for your first child. You may qualify if you're having twins or triplets, or meet other special criteria

rules.description: Claim must be made from 11 weeks before due date to 6 months after birth
rules.reason_if_failed: You can only claim from 11 weeks before your baby's due date. If your baby has already been born, you have up to 6 months to claim

rules.description: Applicant must not be resident in Scotland
rules.reason_if_failed: If you live in Scotland, you cannot get a Sure Start Maternity Grant. You can apply for a Pregnancy and Baby Payment instead

rules.description: If baby already born, claim must be within 6 months of birth
rules.reason_if_failed: You must claim within 6 months of your baby being born. The deadline has passed for this claim

explanation_template: Sure Start Maternity Grant eligibility: {outcome}. Amount: {grant_amount}

edge_cases.description: Having twins/triplets but already have children under 16
edge_cases.action: Calculate reduced grant: £500 if having twins and have 1+ children (not from multiple birth), £1000 if having triplets and have 1 child, £500 if having triplets and already had twins, £0 if already had triplets

edge_cases.description: Applicant has refugee status, humanitarian protection, or came from Afghanistan/Ukraine
edge_cases.action: Grant available for first child born in UK regardless of other children. Verify status documentation.

edge_cases.description: Applying for adoption, surrogacy, guardianship or residence order
edge_cases.action: Baby must be under 1 year old on claim date. Verify legal documentation (parental order, adoption placement, guardianship appointment). Claim within 6 months of placement/order.

edge_cases.description: Claiming for family member under 16 or 16-19 in approved education/training
edge_cases.action: Verify family member lives with applicant. If 16-19, verify enrolled in approved full-time education (A-levels, T-levels, NVQs up to level 3, traineeships) or approved training (not employer-paid, not advanced degree). Must be first child for family member.

edge_cases.description: Child being cared for is someone else's (not partner's) and was over 12 months when arrangement started
edge_cases.action: May qualify for grant. Verify care arrangement and child's age when arrangement began.

edge_cases.description: Application submitted without MAT B1 or health professional evidence to meet deadline
edge_cases.action: Accept application provisionally. Contact applicant within 28 days to arrange provision of MAT B1 form or health professional statement. Cannot complete assessment without evidence.
